node.title: Re^7: @INC error
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
That's strange. Unfortunately I don't know enough about Fedora to give any concrete advice here; it does [https://apps.fedoraproject.org/packages/perl|look like] that's the correct package. Have you tried uninstalling the package first, and/or forcing its installation?

You can get the Perl source at [https://www.perl.org/get.html#unix_like], as well as precompiled binaries, although in my experience those are rarely needed on *NIX. You can theoretically build a system Perl from scratch, but I'm pretty sure using Fedora's packages will be better in the long run.
